_leia: Prompts da arte final gerada pelo NidraIA. Uso: .\arte_fonte\arte.ps1 (veja o cabeçalho do script). modo 'base': parte do sprite procedural ampliado (img2img) e recorta pela posição; modo 'textura': gera uma textura e corta tiles 16x16 periódicos; modo 'prancha': vários quadros na mesma imagem. Estilo: RPG top-down 16/32-bit detalhado, vista 3/4 levemente inclinada; era 1 sombria com natureza densa (verdes escuros e frios) engolindo ruínas.
comum: detailed 16-bit top-down RPG game asset, three-quarter top-down view showing the front and the right side, isometric-like angle, soft dark outline, 3 to 4 shading tones per material, many small details, single object centered, isolated on a solid flat pure magenta background, no shadow on the background, no text
comumTextura: detailed 16-bit top-down RPG game ground tile texture, seen from directly above, no objects, no border, flat even pattern filling the whole image
comumPrancha: detailed 16-bit top-down RPG game character sprite sheet, soft dark outline, on a solid flat pure magenta background
comumVistas: detailed 16-bit top-down RPG game character, character turnaround sheet with three views of the very same character side by side: front view on the left facing the viewer with the face and eyes visible, back view in the middle, right side profile view on the right, full body standing pose, soft dark outline, on a solid flat pure magenta background, no text
eraSombria: gloomy overcast mood, muted cold dark greens like moss, pine and dark olive, blackened wood, damp stone, faint mist
negativo: text, watermark, frame, border, multiple objects, gradient background, scenery, ground, floor, grass around, lime green, neon
